purpose: Teach: お手数/公費/机上/納める/コーポレート/コメンテーター/盛り込む/旅先

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お忙しいところ、本気で、絶対、お手数、絶対、お掛けしますが、絶対、ご協力、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: I'm truly sorry to impose on your time, but I really do need your help with this.
lines.style: Apologetic opening with a slight bow in the voice. Rapid but measured delivery. Respectful distance maintained. Small pause before the ask — gathering courage to continue.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修費は、本気で、絶対、公費、絶対、申請、絶対、可能と、絶対、確認いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've confirmed that training expenses can absolutely be submitted as public funds.
lines.style: Crisp professional affirmation. Slight emphasis on the confirmed detail. Even tempo, steady eye-contact level. A touch of quiet pride in having done the legwork.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 机上の、本気で、絶対、計算、絶対、現場とは、絶対、ずれること、絶対、ありますね
lines.en: Though calculations on paper and what actually happens in the field don't always align, do they.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost thinking aloud. Slight uplift at the end — not quite a question, more an invitation to agree. Warm but slightly tired, the voice of someone who's seen this mismatch before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、法人税、絶対、適正に、絶対、納める、絶対、よう、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We make absolutely certain that our corporate tax obligations are met properly and in full.
lines.style: Formal, careful enunciation. Weight on the compliance details. Steady, responsible tone — the voice of someone stating fact without needing to convince. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: コーポレート、本気で、絶対、ロゴ、絶対、刷新、絶対、検討、絶対、しましょうか
lines.en: Should we look into refreshing the corporate logo as well?
lines.style: Thoughtful, open-ended. Pace slows slightly — considering the idea as she speaks it. Genuine question, not rhetorical. Slight hopeful lilt at the end, like she's testing whether the idea lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。テレビの、本気で、絶対、コメンテーター、絶対、当社の取材、絶対、来ていただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We had a television commentator come in to cover our company — that was a good opportunity.
lines.style: Smooth update delivery. Pride in the achievement but understated. Tempo even and professional. Slight satisfaction at the detail, like checking an item off a list with care.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規プロジェクト、本気で、絶対、各部署の意見、絶対、盛り込むこと、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with the new project and make sure we're incorporating input from all departments.
lines.style: Clear directive, decisive but collaborative in tone. Slight lift on 'departments' — inclusive, not top-down. Steady, purposeful pace. The voice of someone taking the lead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外出張、本気で、絶対、旅先、絶対、宿泊、絶対、手配、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're already working on arranging accommodation for the overseas trip and moving things along.
lines.style: Efficient close. Clipped but warm. Professional summary tone — showing progress and readiness. Final phrase lands with quiet competence, the satisfaction of wheels in motion.
